channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 16 sources. Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
item.description: The new Astra and Sol variants of GPT-6.2 deliver better professional output, coding, and computer use at lower cost, now live across the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work.

item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
item.description: GitHub Copilot now offers GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, OpenAI's newest models built for agentic coding and code review.

item.title: Release v0.28.1-preview.0
item.description: A Qwen Code preview update that verifies scheduled triggers for managed agents and hardens state checks and container setup.

item.title: LangSmith for Coding Agents: Now track spend by outcome
item.description: LangSmith adds reporting for coding agents that ties their spending to the pull requests they ship, letting teams weigh the investment by actual results.

item.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
item.description: The Gemini app has lowered the memory bar for Android devices, so phones with less memory can now use Gemini Live and custom image creation.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
item.description: GitHub Copilot Fusion now ships with more models on more Copilot surfaces, plus results on two public Terminal-Bench leaderboards.

item.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
item.description: The GitHub Copilot app now works with Azure DevOps repositories, GitHub Enterprise Server instances, and the browser, as part of a batch of Ignite releases.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
item.description: The JetBrains edition of GitHub Copilot now offers remote access, voice dictation that runs on your machine, and controls for browser use, alongside context usage shortcuts and a way to review past diffs.

item.title: Monitor GitHub Copilot activity through Microsoft Agent 365
item.description: Companies can now pipe GitHub Copilot agent activity into Microsoft Agent 365 for unified auditing inside Microsoft's agent control plane.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview
item.description: Copilot Evals has opened to everyone in preview, so you can keep refining Copilot's real-world performance as your prompts, models, and skills change.
Claude Code 2.1.327 now confirms before /install-github-app touches a repository, and claude mcp add-json can take server JSON from stdin so tokens stay off the command line.

item.title: Release v0.27.4-nightly.20261116.eb3a599ef3
item.description: A nightly Qwen Code build with the latest changes, including the web-shell workspace filter and the DingTalk adapter for managed agents.

item.title: Lessons learned from one million evaluations
item.description: The Kiro team reviews one million evaluations and explains why fixed task sets with binary pass rates can mislead, and what works better.

item.title: Time-Series Models in the Streamhouse: A New Frontier and Use Cases
item.description: IBM Research shows how time-series models run inside Streamhouse, aimed at forecasting and analysis over live data streams.

item.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
item.description: A 180B-parameter MoE model can now run on just 32GB of RAM, as Transformers streams experts on demand to make large-model inference friendlier to ordinary hardware.

item.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
item.description: OpenAI's models helped optimize circuits for Jalapeño silicon and RISC-V core designs, a concrete step forward for AI-assisted chip design.

item.title: Protect sensitive data in your traces: new controls in LangSmith
item.description: LangSmith has added new access controls that help teams manage sensitive information inside trace data, so each member only sees what their permissions allow.

item.title: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
item.description: GitHub Copilot code review now scales its effort to each pull request — light for routine changes, deeper for complex ones — and catches leaked secrets more reliably.

item.title: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Microsoft's newest AI coding models, MAI Code 2 and its lighter sibling MAI Code 2 Flash, have landed in GitHub Copilot.

item.title: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
item.description: The GitHub Copilot CLI now lets you sign in with Microsoft Entra in public preview, quietly authenticating a linked GitHub Enterprise Managed User.
